_schema: Written by the news analyst. pairs[PAIR] = {rating: bullish|bearish|neutral, confidence: low|medium|high, ts_utc (actual rating time, ISO 8601 UTC), summary, sources[], flagged_news[] (news affecting open trades)}. A rating is valid for news_gate.fresh_hours (4h). If no rating is under news_gate.fail_open_after_hours (~5h) old, the gate fails open.

macro.note: Optional free-text macro context. events[] is used by the macro window when macro_window.enabled is true.
